title: PICTOS API v1 comprender request 1.1.0
description: POST /api/v1/comprender. One utterance in, one NLU generation artifact out.

utterance.description: Preserved exactly; the returned NLU must carry the identical string.

config.description: Subset of PICTOS GlobalConfig that affects COMPRENDER. Names match the native GlobalConfig.

lang.description: BCP 47 tag for the NLU vocabulary and NSM primes.

domainContext.description: Semantic domain used to resolve ambiguity (for example hospital).

model.description: Model id from the pictos.net catalog for this phase. Availability changes over time, so it is not enumerated here: a retired or unknown id is rejected with invalid_request (/model). Omit to use the current default, reported in the response under model.requested.
